rows.jyutping: tyut3 joeng5 hat6 tong4 hat6 syun1
rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese term for the genetic material in a living thing.

example.english: Scientists say this virus can alter the DNA in the human body.
example.traditional: 科學家話呢種病毒會改變人體入面嘅脫氧核糖核酸。
